posts.headline: Fifty-one editions in and Thicks still hasn't bought a single receipt — Klint's Clipboard sits 6-2 but 934.5 points-for is the softest resume a ring has ever worn in this league.
posts.detail: A career finish average of 5.5 with the title already attached tells you everything: the hardware happened, but the weekly dominance never has.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers are no longer the surprise of the league, triciagloston IS the league right now.
posts.detail: 1128.92 points-for leads everybody and the 6-2 record backs it up — a 5-finish pedigree a year ago means nothing against this current stat line.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT is still winless at 0-8, and Eli's Ultimate Light Skin has become this league's longest-running plague.
posts.detail: A 0-8 record with 874.99 points-for means he's not even losing competitively — he's just drafting defensive players first overall and reaping the whirlwind.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's Put it in Ra remains frozen at 2-6, and the greatest résumé this league has ever seen keeps rotting in real time.
posts.detail: A 20-8 career record and a 1.5 average finish are now attached to a team scoring 874.16 points — this is the single biggest fall from grace in Busters Anonymous history.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh is still the worst show on TV at 1-7, and the name has never been a crueler joke.
posts.detail: 798.32 points-for and a career 4-10 record with an average finish of 12th — there's nothing talented here except the branding.
